thread:
Eleanor Shaw: Quick heads-up — Meridian Health renewal prep. We need an interactive SLO dashboard + one-pager: 30d & 90d uptimes, p95 main latency, synthetic check summaries, shadow/fallback counts, incident bullets, enablement feedback capture, and a clear worked credits example. Can eng + enablement + billing assemble? :spiral_calendar:

Devon Brooks: I'll pull metrics + synthetic probe exports. Which service/regions? Also confirm if we should include traffic-split for weighted uptime.

Sofia Martinez: I ran two enablement sessions last week — Meridian asked about codifying looser p95 targets for batch endpoints. I'll upload verbatim notes. They also requested an "SLA sensitivity" slide showing credit impact for small uptime deltas.

Alexei Ivanov: Service = meridian-api-v2. Regions = us-east-1 primary, us-west-2 secondary, eu-central-1 backup. Will mark Dedicated reserved windows as excluded per contract.

Rhea Kapoor: I'll draft the customer-facing narrative and the appendix with exact contract clause for credits. Billing has custom tiers for Meridian, right?

SLAReviewBot: Contract MR-2026-99: tiers => >=99.97% = 0% credit; 99.92-99.97% = 2% credit; 99.8-99.92% = 6% credit; <99.8% = 12% credit. Credits are pro-rata against monthly committed spend and applied on the next invoice after Redwood validation.

Devon Brooks: Running exports now. Repro command: ```bash
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/slo?service=meridian-api-v2&period=30d,90d&group=region,p95,p99,synthetic" | jq .
```
I'll upload CSV + synthetic logs to /shared/reports/meridian/3234567890.

Alexei Ivanov: Note: shadow routing to eu-central-1 occurred 18 times (sub-second). EU synthetic probes show higher p95 during peak windows. I'll annotate timestamps in the CSV.

Sofia Martinez: From enablement: Meridian ops quote — "nightly batch spikes 02:00-03:30 UTC; acceptable if marked as maintenance/exemption but want it explicit." I'll paste call quotes into the folder.

Devon Brooks: Uploaded metrics.csv and synth_checks.zip. Quick summary (30d): us-east-1 uptime=99.955%; us-west-2 uptime=99.889%; eu-central-1 uptime=99.997%. p95_us-east-1=145ms; p95_us-west-2=520ms; p95_eu-central-1=180ms. fallback_count_90d=18. scheduled_maint_excluded=true.

Rhea Kapoor: Draft narrative uploaded. Worked credit example: monthly commit = $60,000; use MR-2026-99 tiers. Regional calc: us-west-2 30d = 99.889% -> falls in 99.8-99.92 => 6% credit = $3,600. Need weighted global example (Devon can provide traffic split).

Devon Brooks: Traffic split (30d): us-east-1 70%, us-west-2 20%, eu-central-1 10%. Weighted uptime = 0.7*99.955 + 0.2*99.889 + 0.1*99.997 = 99.946% -> falls in 99.92-99.97 => 2% credit = $1,200. I'll add exact math to slides.

Alexei Ivanov: Also flag scheduled nightly maintenance 02:15-03:00 UTC on 2027-08-14 is excluded per contract; if included, us-east-1 drops to 99.912%. I attached incl/excl figures.

Sofia Martinez: Uploaded verbatim feedback and a proposed SLO tolerance change request: lower p95 target for batch endpoints to 600ms during maintenance windows and document as operational exemption pre-renewal.

Rhea Kapoor: Legal wording uploaded. Added FAQ: "How do enablement requests affect contract terms?" Answer: operational exemptions can be documented for negotiation but require contract amendment to change formal SLA.

Devon Brooks: Slides + interactive Grafana dashboard link uploaded (internal). Also exported a PNG for the customer packet. Repro snippet for weighted uptime: ```python
weights = {'us-east-1':0.7,'us-west-2':0.2,'eu-central-1':0.1}
uptimes = {'us-east-1':99.955,'us-west-2':99.889,'eu-central-1':99.997}
weighted = sum(weights[r]*uptimes[r] for r in weights)
print(round(weighted,3))
```

Alexei Ivanov: One more metric note: p99 spikes correlate with a third-party DB degradation on 2027-07-30; RCA link in folder.

Sofia Martinez: I'll draft a short exec-facing renewal risk blurb summarizing customer sentiment from enablement calls and the requested exemption. Will ask Legal for amendment path.

Rhea Kapoor: Timeline: internal review tomorrow 2pm PT, customer packet by Monday. CSM wants an "exec ask" line if we need sign-off to offer the operational exemption before contract amendment. Sofia please draft that.

Devon Brooks: All files uploaded. Ping when review complete or if we need additional synth probes.

Eleanor Shaw: Thanks team — I'll run the review and loop in renewals + execs after sign-off. If anyone updates data, update CSV in the folder and ping here. :white_check_mark:
